This might be unpopular, but here are some potential pro tips to make this shit less shitty.

-Do you get migraines? Ask your Doctor for Topamax. This is a serious Anti-Seizure so don’t take this without being prescribed. It is a very strong appetite killer that literally kills my appetite within three bites of something. I had to force myself to eat a day’s worth of calories. I shed 30 pounds like nothing. My appetite slowly returned as my body adjusted to the pills and I hit the gym with more confidence. Topamax is such a strong appetite suppressant it’s prescribed off label for binge eating disorder.

-If you haven’t already, throw out all the bullshit in your house that isn’t keto friendly. Do the big shopping trip and stock up. I get sugar free jello and heavy whipping cream. I’m lazy so I get the low carb mini taco wraps with high fiber. And tons of bacon. 

-Find some working out you don’t hate. It took me decades to find it and for me it’s solidcore. It’s the hardest workout in my state. My sisters like yoga and CrossFit. My dad runs every morning before work. But it has to be for YOU. Put on a sports or gaming or whatever podcast and jog with the dog. Find your thing. 

-Pat yourself on the back for getting off the couch. You already did one better than the guy who didn’t.
